summary: Rick Beaty, 59, of Grand Junction (former Grand Junction fire chief) jumped into the Gunnison River near Whitewater during a float trip with friends without wearing a life jacket; friends searched unsuccessfully and called 911 ~5:15 p.m.; multi-day Mesa County SAR + Sheriff's Office boat, swimmer and spotter search; body recovered Friday 2014-09-05, coroner ruled accidental drowning
responding_agency: Mesa County Search and Rescue; Mesa County Sheriff's Office
notes: Inserted 2026-09-15 (run 545, Mesa CrimeWatch line). Jump reported ~5:15 p.m. Tue 2014-09-02; search suspended ~4:30 p.m. Wed Sept 3, resumed Thu Sept 4; body recovered Fri 2014-09-05; coroner ruled accidental drowning.
